features.title: Decoupled 2D ECS Core Engine
features.description: Pure 100% game-agnostic engine in /Server/ with generic ECS abilities, Quadtree spatial index, layer-based network synchronization, and tick loop.

features.title: Newtonian Elastic Impulse & Momentum Physics
features.description: Complete 2D physical circle collision solver conserving linear momentum (m1*v1 + m2*v2), restitution coefficient, and Coulomb tangential friction.

features.title: Game & Player Finite State Machines (FSM)
features.description: Lifecycle managers for match rounds (Lobby, 3-min RoundActive, RoundOver celebration) and players (3.5s spawn invulnerability shield aura).

features.title: Reynolds Context Steering Autonomous Bot AI
features.description: Fluid steering AI replacing vibrating jitter with angular inertia velocity lerping (alpha=0.20), target commitment locking, predator evasion, and boundary repulsion.

features.title: Area-Based Mass Growth & Pellet Balancing
features.description: Sleek 3.5px food pellets with physics-accurate area growth (sqrt(r^2 + 2.5)), preventing runaway ballooning and providing diminishing returns for large blobs.

features.title: Cell Splitting & Mass Ejection
features.description: Spacebar tactical cell splitting into projectile halves with impulse boost and recombine timer, plus 'W' mass pellet ejection.

features.title: Tactical Bot Splitting AI
features.description: Autonomous AI bots assess opportunities to split-kill smaller players when within lethal strike range and recombine safely.
